notes: Three things the report was getting wrong, found the first time it was used for real. It said the update check had never run, when it had - the time was stored under a name it was not reading. It said no reports folder was chosen, when this extension has never had that option at all. And where a report already described itself, the numbers were printed twice.
None of these were guesses. A report that is confidently wrong is worse than no report, because it sends whoever is reading it somewhere else.
